EmailTemplate.name: CL-New Client 1 of 3 Welcome to Service
EmailTemplate.subject: Service Team Introduction
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Attach client contact sheet
Dear Client,
Welcome again to Insperity. I’m excited you’ve joined Insperity and am looking forward to our partnership. I’ve attached a client contact sheet that introduces you to your dedicated service team including, your Payroll Specialist [name] and the manager of our service team, [name]. I would like to schedule a 30-minute virtual meeting to introduce ourselves, review any questions, and discuss our partnership moving forward. Are you available to meet at either of the following times?
[insert date and time] [insert date and time]
If not, please suggest alternate times that best work for your schedule. In advance of our meeting, I encourage you to review a short 3 ½ -minute Welcome video. This video introduces you to senior leaders at Insperity and provides a glimpse of how Insperity is invested in your long-term business success.
I also invite you to attend the Welcome to Insperity Services for Leaders webinar on June 19 at 12.00 C.T. You’ll learn more about the myriad of ways Insperity supports you in compliance, technology, HR Infrastructure and partnership with your service team. Attendance at this webinar will enhance our time together in strategic planning sessions and prepare you for our discussions.
You can find more information in the attached flyer including a registration link to reserve your spot.
I look forward to talking with you soon.
Best regards,
[signature]
